name: Globeride, Inc.
summary: Globeride, Inc. manufactures and sells sports and leisure products in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. The company offers fishing, golf, tennis, cycling equipment, and racquet sports. It is also involved in the sells sports equipment; parts and repairs sports equipment; and warehouse and cargo handling operations. It offers its products under the DAIWA, DAIWA Pier 39, ONOFF, Daiwa GIII, Roddio, Fourteen, Prince, DiaDem, Corratec, and FOCUS brand names. Globeride, Inc. was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
